admission.justification: Realized across both DiagnosticExecutionEngine._admit_authority and FinalCodexExecutionEngine._admit_authority and guarded by two continuation regression tests that verify schemaVersion and declaration_digest.

conditions: A prior Dagger runtime authority snapshot is reused for a continuation run.
exclusions: Fresh non-continuation authority admissions that mint a new host declaration directly.
statement: Continuation admission in DiagnosticExecutionEngine and FinalCodexExecutionEngine builds DaggerHostDeclaration with AUTHORITY_SCHEMA_VERSION so schema_version, manifest schemaVersion, and declaration_digest remain valid without a type-ignore suppression.
title: Quality continuation admission declares AUTHORITY_SCHEMA_VERSION
